title: LVS: Local View Synthesis from Relative Camera Pose by Reusing Previous Views
abstract: arXiv:2610.12127v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interactive scene exploration requires frequent view updates, although small camera motions preserve much of the visible content. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting nevertheless renders each target view, leaving this image overlap unexploited. Reusing rendered images offers an alternative. Geometric warping alone cannot recover newly exposed content and remains sensitive to depth errors. We propose a per-scene framework that replaces repeated scene rendering for nearby views with relative-pose-guided RGB-D image reuse. Geometric warping uses depth and relative pose to transport source content, while a lightweight multiscale network predicts RGB residuals to correct artifacts and infer missing appearance. Cached source features further reduce repeated computation. translated_title: LVS：通过复用先前视角并利用相对相机位姿实现局部视图合成
translated_abstract: 交互式场景探索需要频繁更新视角，尽管小幅相机运动会保留大部分可见内容。然而，传统的3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）仍需对每个目标视角进行渲染，未能利用这种图像重叠。复用已渲染的图像提供了一种替代方案，但单纯的几何形变无法恢复新暴露的内容，且对深度误差较为敏感。我们提出了一种逐场景（per-scene）框架，用相对位姿引导的RGB-D图像复用替代对邻近视角的重复场景渲染。几何形变利用深度和相对位姿来传递源内容，同时由一个轻量级多尺度网络预测RGB残差，以修正伪影并推断缺失的外观。缓存的源特征进一步减少了重复计算。在GS-render数据集上，残差精修相比纯形变方法将PSNR提升了0.72 dB；在真实采集场景和渲染场景上的评估均展示了较低的查询延迟。这种场景分离方法……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了局部视图合成框架LVS，通过相对相机位姿引导的RGB-D图像复用与轻量级残差网络精修，替代邻近视角的重复3D渲染，实现了低延迟的交互式场景探索。
en_tdlr: LVS proposes a local view synthesis framework that replaces repeated 3D rendering for nearby views with relative-pose-guided RGB-D image reuse and lightweight residual refinement, enabling low-latency interactive scene exploration.
